fixed_heldout_work_metadata_only.title: واژه ای چند از آذرباد مهرسپندان

acceptance_policy: Accept the named, hash-bound source resources now; do not repeatedly relabel identified books as unknown.
Staged lexical groups have verified mechanical fidelity, not universal philological certification.
Generic lexicon resource acceptance is separate from manuscript/quotation clearance for future learning, retrieval or contextual examples.
English/German/French/Parthian/Armenian-related evidence remains a separately labeled resource; no automatic language exclusion or synthetic Persian targets.
Known held-out work families stay protected across editions, glossaries, target languages and source-only uses. Unknown passage lineage is not clearance.
Keep complete published senses, grammatical scopes and provenance; multiple strings are not automatically semantic polysemy, and one record may contain multiple senses.

mmp_nonempty_shape_reconciliation.interpretation: The original1991 count measures one nonempty trc group and sense under a single exact MP label. Requiring at least one Unicode letter or number in both leaves1990 text-bearing shapes. Neither count certifies meaning correctness, manuscript lineage or training eligibility.

polysemy_examples_without_heldout_answer.case: Same mādayān form, noun/adjective readings; preserve scope.
Different published frāz dādan renderings; require attested context before choosing.
Paraphrase variation is not automatically independent new sense evidence.
Numbered senses inside one entry; current multiple-record-sense flag is not a complete polysemy detector.

limitations: All collections mechanically inspected by metadata/count/schema; no claim all meanings manually read or certified.
No held-out translations copied; only work-title metadata used.
Catalogue declaration is not a license or per-record language verification; intended derived-use rights remain separately scoped.
No training design, model calls, external API, downloads, Gemini, Drive or changes to frozen evidence.
